title: World Desk
subtitle: Five thousand years of recorded events, plus a live public-news cache.
disclaimer: This is a desk of major recorded events, not a complete newscast and not a verdict. Religious lifetimes — including many Hindu gurus — use traditional dates. Live pins are outlet-country coverage, not verified incidents.

events.title: Uruk at its early peak
events.summary: One of the first true cities, in Sumer. Writing and monumental temples take shape.
events.source: Standard historical chronology; traditional religious dates flagged.

events.source: Standard historical chronology; traditional religious dates flagged.

events.title: Dancing Girl bronze, Mohenjo-daro

events.title: Pashupati / proto-Shiva seal

events.title: Kanishka (approximate accession)
